proposed_decisions: Bib key Barwise1985BackgroundAims duplicates the identical entry in intake-p03-comparison-games-and-infinitary-languages-w03-p03-041.bib; dedupe at merge.

Keys Ziegler1985TopologicalModelTheory and Steinhorn1985BorelMeasureCategory may collide in role with keys chosen by w03-p03-051/052 for the same chapters (w03-p03-051 uses FlumZiegler1980TopologicalModelTheory for a different work); merge to one key per chapter and update the cites here.
lambda is used locally for the coin-flipping measure on 2^omega (scope sec:p03-w03-p03-053-measure-category); disjoint from the cardinal and lambda-abstraction roles.

Q_c, Q_m: if w03-p03-052 adopts Steinhorn's own notation for the category and measure quantifiers, record both roles and the bridge (this chapter's are the general Polish-carrier large-section quantifiers).
models_{fin} (scope sec:p03-w03-p03-053-finite) is local finite consequence; if the registry already has a finite-consequence symbol from P3 finite model theory, prefer that and rename here.
models_{top} (scope sec:p03-w03-p03-053-l2-interpolation) is local consequence over topological structures; psi_1, psi_2, Fin' are local names.
